text:
sarah: onboarding attempt for tenant `zenith-inc` failing during SCIM POST /Users. API returns 400 invalid displayName bytes and KMS reports decrypt header errors. repro in staging.

mike: can you paste the minimal log lines?

sarah: logs:
```
2024-06-12T09:30:21Z scim-provisioner ERROR tenant=zenith-inc POST /scim/v2/Users 400 {\"detail\":\"invalid displayName bytes\"}
2024-06-12T09:30:21Z kms-client ERROR tenant=zenith-inc decrypt unwrap: invalid header (0x81)
```

chen: invalid header usually = envelope format mismatch or alias rewrap mismatch. any recent rewraps for zenith?

mike: infra shows a partial rewrap to alias/redwood-zenith-v3 last night; config still points to alias/redwood-zenith.

julie: IdP (Okta) shows some users with decomposed unicode (NFD) — combining marks after letters. our previous envelopes were created from NFC-normalized strings. if rewrap happened after a normalization-change, raw bytes differ.

sarah: i made a staging repro: pre-rewrap header 0x01, post-rewrap 0x81. provisioning fails until i normalize displayName to NFC in the SCIM adapter.

iam-bot: [alert] scim-provisioning-failure detected tenant=zenith-inc incident=INC-20240612-44

chen: short mitigation: pause KMS alias rollout for zenith, add NFC normalization step in adapter, and add fallback RBAC mapping by email/externalId (displayName is unreliable).

mike: agreed. i'll coordinate KMS rollback and schedule a short maintenance window for prod patch. assigning: chen (envelope diffs + hexdump), sarah (deploy staging fix to prod), julie (RBAC mapping ticket + tests).

sarah: staging deploy with NFC normalization passes. will follow up with a postmortem and regression test PR.
